title: Measure pipeline bottlenecks and review versioned improvements
description: Aggregate per-stage work versus waiting time, rerun/check/approval failures and known costs. Support configurable evidence-backed review after sufficient samples (five as a starting suggestion, not universal law). Log proposed change and expected metric; owner approves revised definitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Compatible versions can be compared without mixing incompatible stage definitions
Unknown or incomplete measurement is clearly labelled
Review proposals retain baseline evidence and do not silently alter active pipelines
